scientific_integrity: Complete analytic SVD proof is given; exact symbolic factor checks and an independently generated 30-vertex example are reproducibility diagnostics, not replacements for proof.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on a finite thick generalized quadrangle existing; kernel must depend only on graph distance. Equivalent treatments in the literature on bipartite coherent configurations remain possible. No independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
title: Exact positivity cone of distance-radial kernels on finite generalized quadrangles
